create_benchmark: create a benchmark instance using create_benchmark with execution_params dict specifying ab or locust backend
run_ab_benchmark: run an Apache Bench performance test by creating ABBenchmark and calling its warm_up and run methods
run_locust_benchmark: run a Locust load test by creating LocustBenchmark and calling its warm_up and run methods
generate_benchmark_report: generate a CSV report and optional latency and profile graphs by calling generate_report on a Benchmark instance
prepare_benchmark_environment: prepare the benchmark environment by calling prepare_environment to set up tmp directories and copy input files
